pages.text: While my rituals are useful, I must sometimes spend time away from my base where I do not have access to them. In such an emergency, I can leave a driftwood effigy of myself in my place.

The effigy maintains a sympathetic resonance with the one who placed it. There are some obvious effects - if the effigy is attacked, so am I. If it is set on fire, so am I. More usefully, when placed in a ritual, the ritual will apply to me as if I was in the ritual myself.
